verses.text:
Nandri sollamal irukkave mudiyathu
Pala nanmai seitha Yesuvukku
Nandri nandri nandri endru solli naan thuthippen
Naalthorum potruven
Naalthorum potruven

Ummai aaradhhippen aandavare
Ummai potruven Yesuve

En vaalvin ella naalum
Ummai naan thuthippen
En idhayam muzhuvadhum
Ummai naan nesippen

Yesuve en nambikkai
En ratchagar neere

Irul soozhntha nerangalil
Oli thanthavar neere
Thunbam varum velaiyil
Thunai nindravar neere

Aandavare ummai thuthippen
En ullam muzhuvadhum potruven

Umadhu kirubai pothum enakku
En vaalkai muzhuvadhum
Umadhu anbu soozhnthidume
En ullam nirainthidume

Devan nallavar endrum nallavar
Avar kirubai nilaithirukkume

En vaalvil seitha nanmaigal
Ennikaiyilathavai
Avar anbu endrum maaradhadhu
En ullam magizhgiradhu
